Use case: infographic-diagram.
Create one polished high-resolution landscape Chinese technical architecture infographic, roughly 2400x1600, crisp readable Chinese sans-serif typography, white background, flat professional documentation aesthetic, clean orthogonal arrows, generous spacing. It must be a standalone image, not a photograph or mockup. No decorative robots or phones. Accuracy and readable hierarchy are more important than decoration.
This is one of a matching pair explaining the CURRENT Tripoder Android source. Main layout: title at top; left 62% a process/layer architecture; right 38% a numbered vertical startup sequence; bottom a narrow boundary note. Keep system boundaries obvious. Use dark navy text, thin gray process boundaries, mode accent color. A small arrow legend: solid=调用/执行, dashed=控制/票据.
Common startup sequence on the right, use these short Chinese labels in order:
"启动流程"
"1  导入 APK：校验、解析、提交安装"
"2  prepareApplicationLaunch：选择 Launcher / 槽位"
"3  bindService(WorkerN)：必要时 Zygote 创建 :slotN"
"4  LOAD：路径策略 → 类与资源 → Framework Hook"
"5  START_APPLICATION：attach → Provider → onCreate"
"6  签发 Activity Ticket → 工作台 startActivity"
"7  系统调度槽位 Activity → 创建 Guest Activity → 首帧"
Below step 7 show "接管点：performLaunchActivity · newActivity · Activity.attach".
Footer exact text: "两种模式都使用宿主 UID 与系统授权；Application ready 不代表首帧已显示。"
A tiny secondary note: "Provider 顺序为普通路径；部分壳存在延后初始化分支。"
Critical semantic constraints: Worker bind and Guest Application initialization occur BEFORE the workbench startActivity. Zygote is used only if a physical slot process does not already exist. No root, no external process injection, no independent guest Android OS, no independent guest UID. Android retains physical components, task/token/window/lifecycle/rendering. Do not claim all Java calls are hookable or 100% caller coverage. Do not claim zero total IPC. The imported APK's code executes inside a host-owned slot process.

Mode: THIN. Accent teal/cyan.
Title exact: "Tripoder · THIN 模式"
Subtitle exact: "默认薄壳透传｜必要映射与接管，优先复用真实 Android"
Architecture on the left:
An outer boundary "宿主 APK · 多进程共享 UID" contains three process boxes:
A small "主进程" box with "工作台 / MCP".
A small ":authority" box with "安装与空间 / 进程分配 / 根启动票据" and "SQLite 权威状态".
A larger ":slotN · Guest 执行进程" box with 4 levels:
"Guest Application / 四大组件"
"轻量接管：组件映射 · 身份参数 · 路径重定向"
"ART：保留正常 JIT / AOT，Hook 目标按方法处理"
"存储：平台 SharedPreferencesImpl + Guest 数据目录"
The primary thick teal arrow runs from Guest through lightweight adapters to the real Android Framework, then by Binder into a box OUTSIDE host boundary "Android 系统服务". That outside box says "AMS / ATMS / 包管理 / 设备服务" and "真实 Task · Window · 生命周期 · 绘制".
Draw a dashed bidirectional control arrow between :authority and the slot's adapter labeled "首次路由 / 槽位分配 / 必要控制"; show :authority as control support, not mandatory per-call detour.
Show a small side annotation "常见设备服务透传；组件仍需映射".
A shared native strip at bottom of slot: "Native：libc / 选定系统调用 → path_policy".
Under the architecture, "Linux 内核：宿主 UID · SELinux · 权限检查".
A concise mode note: "优势方向：减少中心 IPC 与自实现开销" and "边界：已有内联调用覆盖需单独验证".
Do not imply that every component call bypasses authority; root launch still uses tickets and IPC. Do not imply that all system services are passed through unchanged.
